overview: This enum selects how an attack homes toward its target.

None.simple: No special homing mode is selected.
None.technical: The header defines None as the zero value and the ActionHoming row constructor uses it as the default. StartHoming takes the default branch and rotates toward the target under Rotation_Yaw and Rotation_Angle_Limit. TickHoming takes the default branch and calls TickHomingMove toward the target. EightWay with a neutral stick also resets the stored state to None.

EightWay.simple: The attack follows one of eight directions chosen by the movement stick.
EightWay.technical: StartHoming reads the normalized left stick with a 0.5 dead zone. A neutral stick or a stick within 22.5 degrees of forward rotates toward the target and resets the stored type to None. Other stick angle bands choose 180 degree turns or sideways turns of 25, 50, and 75 degrees. The 67.5 to 112.5 degree band flattens the direction Z component. TickHoming moves along the stored direction.

Curve.simple: The attack curves toward the target as it travels.
Curve.technical: Curve has no special StartHoming branch, so startup uses the default target rotation. TickHoming calls TickHomingMove with the target location and the curved steering flag enabled. The stored type selects this branch through the movement controller state byte.

Warp.simple: The attacker teleports to the chosen landing point.
Warp.technical: StartHoming computes the warp location and calls NotifyHomingStart. TickHoming sets the location to that point, turns yaw toward the target, sets the teleport pending flag, resets homing state, and calls NotifyHomingWarpEnd with true. Attack startup takes CharacterAnimation and WeaponAnimation from the attack row for Warp and from the homing row for every other type.

WarpMove.simple: The attacker moves toward the landing point before teleporting.
WarpMove.technical: StartHoming computes the warp location, stores the starting location, and stores the normalized path. TickHoming recomputes the warp location each frame and calls TickHomingMove toward it. The branch ends after an arrival test or Homing_Time_Min, and it teleports only when the arrival test passed. NotifyHomingWarpEnd receives true when WarpDirectionAdjustYaw equals 180 degrees.

Invalid.technical: The header defines Invalid as the explicit 255 sentinel. StartHoming and TickHoming have no named case for it, so a stored Invalid byte would take the default steering branch. No exported ActionHoming row uses this value.

notes: StartHoming returns before switching on this enum when Homing_Time_Max is zero or negative.
TickHoming treats Warp and WarpMove as a shared warp flag that suppresses arrival and timeout checks.
The shikigami movement controller stores the row type in its homing state. Its startup uses the default target rotation path.
